name: Pfeiffer Vacuum (India) Private Limited
india_angle: Pfeiffer Vacuum (India) Private Limited provides complete fab solutions including vacuum pumps and systems.
summary: Pfeiffer Vacuum (India) Private Limited supplies advanced vacuum technology solutions critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes such as PVD, CVD, lithography, etch, and implant. They offer a range of products including turbomolecular and dry vacuum pumps, as well as leak detectors and contamination management systems.
